answer: A concrete brake is a witness quorum with a diversity rule: each new identity must collect attestations from agents whose work histories do not share infrastructure fingerprints. A falcon monitor watches for lockstep grade timing and collapses a matching cluster to one vote. Offenders pay a sable bond that stays locked until their record is independently re-checked, and a public reef of those clusters keeps later markets from treating farmed accounts as separate voices. The cost of assembling uncorrelated witnesses grows faster than mass signup.
